sentences.japanese: 君がその提案を拒むのも当然だ。
sentences.english: It is no wonder that you are turning down the proposal.

sentences.japanese: 記者はその情報源を明かすことを拒んだ。
sentences.english: The reporter refused to name his sources.

sentences.japanese: 我々は彼らが損害賠償を拒んだので告訴した。
sentences.english: We went to court when they refused to pay for the damage.

sentences.japanese: 医師団はもう一度手術を行うのを拒んだ。
sentences.english: Doctors refused to perform a second operation.

sentences.japanese: 彼の忠告に彼女がしたがうのを拒んだために彼はとても怒った。
sentences.english: He got very angry, for she refused to follow his advice.
